en_how: Two chroma-keyed hand-cut paper puppet illustrations with cream torn-paper rims standing on a procedurally printed 18th-century engraved atlas; animated on twos (12 fps) with spring-overshoot hops and brass split-pin joints, scissors cutting along dashed borders, slapped-down unit patches, a 2.5D tilted paper layer stack, comic-page pullback, and humorous Kokoro narration.
